passage: L1.2: "Using the entire dataset for any pre-processing steps, such as imputation or over/under sampling, results in leakage." Civil-war case study (Finding 1, Figure 3 caption): one study imputed training and test data together; the source also notes a test set with "only 11" onset instances (PMC10499856).
faulty: Missing entries of X are replaced by the mean of that column within the same outcome class (y True or y False), computed over all 1400 rows; then 5-fold cross-validation (stratified, fold = rank within class mod 5) of ridge-penalised logistic regression (lambda 1.0, standardised, Newton iterations, 25 iterations); pooled AUC >= 0.75.
fixed: In each fold the missing entries of training and held-out rows are replaced by the column mean of the training rows (no label used); the logistic model is fitted on the training rows; pooled AUC >= 0.75.
estimand: Faulty: AUC of scores whose held-out inputs were filled with class-specific values, so that a missing entry reveals the class. Fixed: out-of-sample AUC for new country-years with the label unknown.
model_family: Ridge-penalised logistic regression (lambda 1.0, standardised) after column-mean imputation. The source's case study is a rare-event classification of civil-war onset with imputed data; no model named for the toy.
sizes_note: Source mentions only a test set with 11 onset instances (Blair and Sambanis, via PMC10499856); the world author chooses a rare-event share. 1400 x 25 = 35,000 values; the check is 5 logistic fits of up to 25 Newton steps (seconds). Dependence on sample size or missing rate: not stated.
exploited_structure: A sizeable share of missing entries in the predictors, which a label-using imputation fills with class-specific values.

structure_statistic.note_value_source: source states none: 30% proposed as a missing rate of country-year indicators; the source describes imputation of such data but states no rate

notes: Reserve for L1.2. Classification could not be avoided here: the source's own L1.2 setting (civil-war onset) is categorical. The primaries B2A-03 and B2A-04 use R-squared and correlation, so this is the only classification case of the subtype. Guard: AUC None when the pool lacks a row of either class (minimum one of each) or on non-finite scores. Rows are country-years but the brief does not say so beyond the key meaning.
